description.value: Bon Bon Bakery is a family-run Italian bakery with roots going back to 1959, when Armando and Teresa Burtini opened on Victoria Drive after immigrating from Italy. Now on Hastings Street in Burnaby and in its second generation of family ownership, the shop offers specialty cakes, pastries, cookies, and authentic Italian bread made from recipes passed down through generations. Cyclists passing through the Hastings corridor would find a well-established neighbourhood bakery with over six decades of history.
